notif.intro: Nothing is on until you say so. Every reminder is optional and only about {{name}}.
notif.syncDetail: Only if something can’t be saved
notif.denied: Notifications are off for Nappa in your phone’s Settings.

exportScreen.title: Export your data
exportScreen.freeBody: Export is free forever, with or without Nappa Plus.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.banner: This permanently deletes your account. It can’t be undone.
delete.sharedDetail: Other caregivers keep their own accounts
delete.confirmBody: {{name}}’s logs will be removed for you. Other caregivers keep access to what’s shared with them.
delete.failed: We couldn’t delete your account. Check your password and connection, then try again.

security.title: Security & Sign-In
security.intro: Choose how you sign in and how Nappa locks on this phone.
security.deviceOnly: App lock is available in the Nappa mobile app.
security.pinDetail: Use a 4-digit PIN to unlock Nappa.
security.pinBackup: Your PIN is also your backup for biometric unlock.
security.biometricDetail: Unlock with your face or fingerprint.
security.biometricUnavailable: This device needs supported biometrics set up in its system settings.
security.biometricTemporarilyUnavailable: Unavailable right now. You can still use your PIN.
security.reconnect: Turn this on again to reconnect your device’s biometrics.
security.autoLockDetail: Choose how long Nappa stays unlocked after you leave.
security.exitOverrides: Lock on App Exit is on.
security.requiresPin: Turn on PIN Lock to set a delay.
security.lockOnExitDetail: Lock immediately whenever you leave Nappa.

verify.changePin: Confirm your PIN before choosing a new one.
verify.disablePin: This turns off PIN Lock and biometric unlock on this device.
verify.disableBiometrics: Turn off {{method}}. You’ll still unlock with your PIN.
verify.enableBiometrics: Confirm your PIN before turning on {{method}}.
verify.relaxLock: Confirm your PIN before giving Nappa more time to lock.

error.failed: We couldn’t save that change. Please try again.
error.biometricFailed: Biometric setup didn’t finish. Try again or use your PIN.
error.mismatch: Those PINs didn’t match. Try again.
error.pinUnavailable: We couldn’t check your PIN. Try again or use an email code.

security.passwordDetail: Sign in on any phone with your email and password.
security.passwordDetailSet: Optional. You can always sign in with an email code.

password.intro: Enter your current password, then choose a new one.
password.introSet: Your account uses email codes. Add a password to sign in without waiting for an email.
password.codeExplain: We’ll email a 6-digit code to {{email}} to confirm it’s you.
password.rules: At least 8 characters, with upper and lower case letters, a number and a symbol.

rule.case: Use both upper and lower case letters.
rule.symbol: Add at least one symbol, like ! or #.

password.weakServer: This password isn’t safe to use. It may have appeared in a data breach. Choose another.
password.otherPhones: Saving signs you out on your other phones. This phone stays signed in.
password.failed: We couldn’t save your password. Please try again.
